NOT a predefined DE constant — it appears nowhere in random_map.def, so a script using this name must define it itself and our resolver only ever sees the written name. The row exists so that name resolves to a habitat instead of falling through to the 'land' default. CONFIRMED 2026-08-11 against the installed random_map.def (the name is bound nowhere in it) and against the community Definitive Constants List, whose CONST column is empty for both dolphin units, 61 and 452. The dolphin is real and has no constant; that is the whole answer. Unit 61 in empires2_x2_p1.dat carries terrain_restriction 13, which is what the amphibious habitat above is transcribed from. TWO EARLIER VERSIONS OF THIS NOTE ARGUED IT WRONGLY AND BOTH ARE WORTH REMEMBERING. The first cited `#const DOLPHIN 61` as appearing in every tracked corpus use. That FACT is correct and was briefly and wrongly denied here: four corpus files use the bare name (`TL Cape of Storms.rms`, `TL Tres Leches.rms`, `OWWC1Tewaipounamu-edited-v1.2.rms`, `broken/BCC2-Rekawa.rms`) and all four write `#const DOLPHIN 61`, while three DE-official maps write `#const FISH_DOLPHIN 61` instead — a different name that still has no row here. The denial came from a directory search that silently returned nothing, which is why it is recorded rather than quietly fixed. What was wrong with the ORIGINAL note is the inference, not the count: those same maps also `#const SHORE_FISH 69` and `#const FISH_PERCH 53`, names random_map.def already binds, so a map defining a name is not evidence the engine does not. The second read random_map.def's own comments, `#const MARLIN1 450 /* DOLPHIN1 */` and `#const MARLIN2 451 /* DOLPHIN2 */`, and concluded the engine's constant for a dolphin IS marlin. It is not: the community table lists 450 and 451 as Great Fish (Marlin) in every game version, and the dat gives units 61, 450, 451 and 452 the internal names DOLP3, DOLP1, DOLP2 and DOLP3 — 450 is named DOLP1 and is a marlin, and two different units share the name DOLP3. INTERNAL ART NAMES AND SOURCE COMMENTS RECORD WHAT A UNIT WAS COPIED FROM, NOT WHAT IT DEPICTS, and neither is evidence of identity. Note random_map.def also binds 61 to DLC_JUNGLEROAD and ATTR_CHARGE_EVENT: numeric ids are per-namespace, and the unit table is the one that answers this. constId deliberately null: there is no DE constant to take one from, and the id a script happens to pick is that script's business. HABITAT NARROWED 2026-08-08 from 'water' to 'amphibious': restriction 13 permits 38 terrains including every shallow and every beach, which the preview's 'water' class no longer does. The split exists because restriction 19 (the ordinary fish) permits neither.
